name: Amazon 7 image strategy suite
source_logic: Nexscope 7-image planning + Amazon seller slot jobs + tryclair image type catalog
suite_consistency_rules: Every image answers a distinct buyer question.
Use the same product truth pack and style pack for all slots.
Do not repeat the same selling point in every image.
Keep final text short and mobile-readable.
Do not use unsupported exact specs.
